runtime_rule.cover: Only aggregate+asset visual_only, classified event_photo, confidence >= 0.9, safe_crop=true and a focal point may use the 140×112 5:4 cover window.
runtime_rule.contain: OCR, document, unknown, contradictory or crop-unsafe media preserve authored ratio in a 62–199px content-sized wrapper at 112px height.
runtime_rule.no_field_interpretation: For protected media, no internal letterbox is achieved by making the wrapper follow the authored ratio; it is not permission to blind-cover or crop document text.
